instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: A family-owned mixed-crop farm with 120 hectares of irrigated land. We cultivate cereals, vegetables, and olives for domestic wholesale markets in the Mediterranean region. We are exploring precision agriculture technologies to optimize water usage and reduce chemical inputs through basic sensor adoption. As a bootstrapped company with limited capital, every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our highly constrained working capital.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment for irrigation monitoring software. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration within the core tech circle. However, adjacent teams (marketing, support) are still adapting to this faster cadence, leading to process friction.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base—our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including niche specialty crops or entirely new business models that leverage our existing land and cultivation capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The company currently faces high volatility in commodity prices and local labor costs which necessitate continuous operational efficiency improvements alongside strategic growth planning.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Precision Irrigation Optimization Pilot (Core Business)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing basic soil moisture sensors and localized drip irrigation management offers immediate operational efficiency gains for the existing core crops with low capital risk. This aligns perfectly with conservative risk appetite.

first_actions: Identify three pilot plots for sensor installation.
Procure low-cost soil moisture sensors and basic data logging software subscription.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 10% measurable reduction in water usage on pilot plots within the first growing cycle.
milestones: Pilot data analysis and ROI projection completed (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Niche Specialty Crop Value-Added Market Entry (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: To diversify revenue, we can pivot a small portion of land to cultivate high-margin specialty herbs or unique olive varietals. This requires a bold shift in product focus and low initial CAPEX investment.

first_actions: Conduct market research on local organic/gourmet demand for niche products.
Test cultivation of 5 hectares dedicated to a high-value specialty crop.
resources_needed: €3,000 for seed stock and initial packaging
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure one contract with a gourmet retailer paying >2x the standard commodity price.
milestones: First specialty crop harvest and sales made (Month 9)

opportunities.title: Partnership-Led Digital Sales Channel Development (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Instead of building proprietary software, we can partner with existing regional agricultural cooperatives or local wholesalers to co-develop a simple inventory/order management tool. This lowers development risk and leverages external expertise.

first_actions: Identify two potential cooperative partners willing to pilot a shared ordering platform.
Develop a minimal viable product (MVP) using no-code tools.
execution_plan.success_metric: Onboard one external partner successfully to manage 25% of new sales volume.
milestones: Platform MVP launch for pilot partners (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Finalize the budget allocation for the Precision Irrigation Pilot project and assign a timeline.
Conduct initial market segmentation research for specialty crops to validate opportunity #2 feasibility.
Draft a 'Partnership Framework' document identifying potential agricultural cooperative targets.

key_weaknesses: Extreme reliance on single product category and concentrated customer base (55% revenue dependency).
Very low digital maturity (Level 2), limiting scalable operational automation.
Lack of a formal, dedicated engineering team; innovation capacity is entirely dependent on the founder's bandwidth.
Highly constrained working capital (€3% budget) making high-risk R&D investment nearly impossible.
